name: 便携锁温保温午餐软包款
description: 软质保温午餐袋，冷热两用可装饭盒水果，防漏内胆易擦拭，手提单肩两背

styleLock.direction: practical everyday-carry thermal soft bag ecommerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, warm sand #F2EDE6 for infographic and closing frames, matte graphite #3A3A3A for macro panels, lightly tinted twin panels for dual-state comparisons
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even neutral studio light, front-left softbox key with a fill card, soft contact shadows that ground the bag, gentle rim on the woven shell, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte warm sand board #F2EDE6, light-stone desk top #E7E1D8, pale sand #E8DCC8 and woven picnic cotton for lifestyle frames
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif reserved for post compositing only; every rendered frame keeps blank label plates and empty parameter bars, no in-image copy
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and callout leader lines in #E8641B, flat matte tiles only, no glossy 3d badges
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and constant product scale across the set; handles lifted and upright in packshots; open-liner frames show contents without hiding the body; woven texture must stay readable
noDrift: no invented spec numbers, units or percentages
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent practical everyday-carry soft bag ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, warm sand #F2EDE6, charcoal #2D2D2D and one bright orange accent #E8641B; neutral bright even studio lighting with a front-left softbox key, fill card and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif held for post compositing with all in-image copy removed; thin single-weight line icons and callout leader lines in #E8641B; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 在搜索结果里一眼赢得点击，提供干净合规的平台主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level turned a slight 3/4, bag standing upright with both handles lifted, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left softbox key with a fill card, soft contact shadow under the base
shots.whitespace: even margin ring around the product, no extra whitespace blocks
shots.promptTemplate: Product packshot photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bag stands upright with its carry handles lifted, straight-on eye-level view turned a slight 3/4 so the front zip pocket and one side mesh panel are both readable, full product visible inside the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting from a front-left softbox with a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow grounding the base. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. No props. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with an even margin ring and no extra whitespace. Crisp edges, readable woven fabric texture, 8K commercial home-and-kitchen ecommerce quality. Negative: no overlay text, no watermark, no color swatch strip, no badges, no added logo artwork, no hands, no gradient background, no cut-off edges, no floating product without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒讲清冷热两用的核心利益，同一产品在两种状态里都被证明

shots.lighting: identical bright neutral studio light on both panels, front-left key, soft contact shadows; only the panel tint differs
shots.background: left panel cool tinted field #DCE8EE, right panel warm tinted field #F3E1D2
shots.props: left: chilled drinks and fresh fruit nestling in crushed ice; right: warm dishes packed in lidded glass containers
shots.whitespace: narrow clean gutter between the two panels, no extra whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce dual-state comparison screen of {product}, two matched side-by-side panels with identical straight-on eye-level camera, identical crop and identical lighting. Left panel on a cool tinted field #DCE8EE: the bag open with chilled drinks and fresh fruit over crushed ice, fine condensation on the liner. Right panel on a warm tinted field #F3E1D2: the same bag open with warm dishes in lidded glass containers, faint steam only. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright neutral front-left studio light with soft contact shadows on both panels, no other light sources. The product occupies 50-60% of each panel with a narrow clean gutter between panels and no extra whitespace. Negative: no headline or label words, no percentages, no hour or temperature figures, no before-and-after body claims, no real competitor product, no invented results, no watermark, no added logo artwork, no plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no unrealistic portion size.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底 3/4 手提保温软包主图，前袋缝有皮质字标、底部一排多色缩略色卡；002 海滩野餐场景，两人对坐、格纹野餐布、冰桶与水果餐食；003 上半为多层材质卡加橙色引线指到侧壁一点，下半为左右双栏保冷与保温对照；004 白底三围尺寸线、左上容积角标、右上易拉罐比例锚；005 三档尺码纵向阶梯，每档配内容物组合卡；006 左侧三格微距（接缝、水珠、擦拭）加右侧敞口内胆盛水装水果；007 左右双栏通勤手提与单肩背法，男模全身出镜；008 办公桌前开盒用餐场景。品类判定依据：源类目路径挂在 Kitchen & Dining 下的 Storage & Organization 与 Lunch Bags，但按图看它是无电加热的软质保温携行包，靠材质分层锁温，卖的是装饭盒与饮品的厨房餐食携行用途，故归 家居日用/厨房用品，既不入家用电器，也不按通勤包归箱包；多色与多码并列只作 VARIANT 选款镜。已剥离内容：品牌字标与皮质标牌、原平台店铺字样、英文标题与口号原句、容积与三围尺寸数字、保冷时长、材质层名称、渗漏百分比与清洁主张、可辨识模特面容与身份，全部改空白标签板、空参数行与空角标；产品一律以 {product} 占位。
